target_source: Reviewed operator-compiled coarse lateral correction: one measured gold point and inferred channel plane line; no descent/contact

candidate.limitations: One measured gold point toward inferred channel line; unchanged height/attitude/grip; NOT full-card alignment, clearance, contact or insertion; second gold sample rejected

evidence: The current right view supports the visible gold strip and a plausible receiving-channel line beneath it; the three housing-plane projections are consistent with that line.

The supplied horizontal translation, approximately 12.62 mm, brings the single accepted gold-strip point toward the inferred line in XY. This is useful for coarse alignment without requiring insertion precision.
The wrist view supports continued gripper engagement, with native grasp assistance ON. Current views show no definite interference that invalidates this bounded lateral correction.

Approval is limited to the supplied translation with unchanged height, current measured attitude, aperture 0.3, and unchanged per-action tracking guard, for at most 64 actions at 15 Hz. No descent or release.
uncertainty: The rejected second gold sample is not used. One accepted point cannot establish full-card alignment or connector angular alignment.
Channel coordinates are ray intersections with the measured housing plane, not measured opening depth, seating depth, or independently verified semantic identity.
The approximately 89.7 mm sampled vertical gap is not full-object or swept-volume clearance. Occluded card, gripper, and housing geometry remain unverified.
This approval does not authorize contact or insertion; retention and tracking must remain valid throughout the bounded motion.
